what: Gzipped size of the production main chunk (dist/assets/index-*.js), measured by scripts/battery.mjs with Node zlib gzipSync at its default level.
baselineRound: game-feel Round 4d (the Web Audio engine, the cue map, the toggles and the dev sound board)
budgetNote: Threshold set from the Round 2 baseline with headroom for the Web Audio effects module (Round 4d), the outcome cinematics (Round 5) and the procedural music bed (Round 6). Round 3 spent 5072 bytes, Round 3.5 spent 384, Round 4a nothing, Round 4b spent 1122, Round 4c spent 39 net, and Round 4d spent 3477: twenty four synthesized voices, the engine that owns the context and the gesture unlock, the two persisted toggles and the severity mapping. No audio assets, so nothing here is a fetch or a license. The dev sound board is excluded from the build and the battery checks the built output for its marker. jsdom is a dev dependency and adds nothing here. Any library addition records its delta here in its own commit.
headroomNote: Headroom is not recorded here. It is derived by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs from the chunk the battery just measured, because a written headroom describes the baseline it was written against and goes stale the moment a round grows the bundle; Round 4c copied a stale one into its report twice.
